# nemau_regions (Data Source)

The regions that are enabled.

A project's region is chosen when it is created, in the console: no provider resource takes it as an argument.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nemau_regions" "enabled" {}

output "region_slugs" {
  value = data.nemau_regions.enabled.regions[*].slug
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `regions` (Attributes List) The enabled regions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--regions))

### Nested Schema for `regions`

- `display_name` (String) Human-readable name.
- `slug` (String) Short identifier of the region.
